key_reasoning.reason: Pure layout fix with no security or data surface, but no exact precedent covered it. It needed a bounded flex-column height chain from the PageLayout h-full content box through ProjectDetailsPage, a stable content root so tab switches do not remount ProjectDetailsNavigation (a regression the review caught), and a callback-ref ResizeObserver to re-measure the scrollbar gutter in ProjectMembersManager. All three are new local approaches, so this is M and not S.

5 unique files: 3 modified source components (ProjectDetailsPage, ProjectDetailsNavigation, ProjectMembersManager), 1 modified test (ProjectDetailsPage.test.tsx) and 1 new test (ProjectMembersTableScroll.test.tsx), in 2 directories under src/pages/settings/administration. The 4-file diff plus the 2-file review fix-up collapse to 5 unique paths. That falls in the 4-6 band, which is M.

Three components work together through a layout contract: the page wrapper, the sticky tab navigation and the members manager's scroll container. All of them are in the UI layer of one feature area, with no shared utilities or new abstractions. The S calibration example (epmcdme-10102, total 11) agrees with this band.
